desc.ian_image_library:title: Santalum freycinetianum (Freycinet Sandalwood)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Front view illustration of a Freycinet Sandalwood, endemic to the Hawaiian islands. It is found in the mesic to dry forests of O'ahu. The fragrant wood of this shrub or small tree has history as a significant trade commodity through the mid 19th century. Ancient Hawaiians also used the wood, bark and leaves.
